examples_extra: She reads e-books on her new tablet.
The e-book was much cheaper than print.

meaning_en: Commercial transactions conducted electronically on the internet.
example_en: E-commerce has transformed how people shop globally.
examples_extra: Global e-commerce is growing very fast indeed.
She now works in e-commerce logistics full-time.

meaning_en: An article in a newspaper expressing the editor's opinion.
example_en: The editorial criticized the government's new policy.
examples_extra: Today's editorial strongly criticised the new policy.
She wrote a sharp editorial for yesterday's paper.

meaning_en: Learning conducted via electronic media, typically the internet.
example_en: E-learning has become popular for remote education.
examples_extra: E-learning is very convenient for busy workers.
She strongly prefers e-learning to real classrooms.

meaning_en: Designed for efficiency and comfort in the working environment.
example_en: The new office chairs are ergonomically designed for comfort.
examples_extra: This chair is ergonomically designed for long hours.
The keyboard is ergonomically designed to reduce strain.
note_fa: طراحی ارگونومیک؛ برای راحتی و کارایی.

meaning_en: A prominent article or broadcast on a specific topic.
example_en: The newspaper ran a feature on local environmental efforts.
examples_extra: The magazine ran a feature on AI.
Safety is a key feature.

meaning_en: The practice of distributing or providing access to digital media.
example_en: Illegal file-sharing remains a challenge for the music industry.
examples_extra: File-sharing is very common online.
The site was shut for illegal file-sharing.

meaning_en: To remove unwanted elements or information.
example_en: The software helps to filter out spam emails.
examples_extra: The system filters out spam.
Filter out the noise first.

meaning_en: A small printed sheet advertising an event or product.
example_en: They handed out flyers for the new restaurant.
examples_extra: She handed out flyers downtown.
I saw the flyer for the concert.

meaning_en: The activity of playing video games.
example_en: Online gaming has become incredibly popular worldwide.
examples_extra: Online gaming is very popular.
She spends hours gaming every night.

meaning_en: Smooth and shiny; often referring to magazines.
example_en: She subscribes to several glossy fashion magazines.
examples_extra: She has long glossy hair.
The glossy magazine costs five pounds.

meaning_en: A very clear and often disturbing picture.
example_en: The news report showed graphic images of the accident.
examples_extra: The news showed graphic images.
The report contains graphic images of war.

meaning_en: Certain to attract a lot of attention.
example_en: Her new dress was guaranteed to turn heads.
examples_extra: Her dress is guaranteed to turn heads.
The car is guaranteed to turn heads.
note_fa: اصطلاح: حتماً توجه همه را جلب می‌کند.

meaning_en: A journalist who writes quickly without much skill.
example_en: He dismissed the article as the work of a lazy hack.
examples_extra: The paper hired a hack.
He writes like a tired hack.
note_fa: در این معنا: روزنامه‌نگار بی‌استعداد؛ hack (فعل) یعنی هک کردن.

meaning_en: Living in great comfort with expensive things.
example_en: After winning the lottery, they lived in the lap of luxury.
examples_extra: They live in the lap of luxury.
She grew up in the lap of luxury.

meaning_en: To allow oneself to enjoy a pleasure or desire.
example_en: I decided to indulge myself with a relaxing spa day.
examples_extra: Indulge yourself with a nice dessert.
He indulged in a long holiday.
note_fa: indulge yourself یعنی به خودت حال بدهی.

meaning_en: Featuring new ideas, methods, or creativity.
example_en: The company is known for its innovative product designs.
examples_extra: The company is known for innovative design.
She proposed an innovative solution.

meaning_en: A small printed sheet of paper, often for advertising.
example_en: They handed out leaflets promoting the new restaurant.
examples_extra: They handed out leaflets in the street.
The leaflet explains the new bus routes.

meaning_en: To be much better than all other similar things.
example_en: Her performance left all other competitors standing.
examples_extra: This phone leaves other things standing.
Her cooking leaves other things standing.

meaning_en: To depart from a person or group.
example_en: The reporter chose to leave the network after a dispute.
examples_extra: She will never leave her husband.
Do not leave your children alone.

meaning_en: A symbol or design representing an organization.
example_en: The company redesigned its logo for a modern look.
examples_extra: The company's logo is well known.
The shirt has a small logo.

meaning_en: An online discussion forum for specific topics.
example_en: He found useful information in a newsgroup about vintage cars.
examples_extra: He posted a tricky question in a newsgroup.
The busy newsgroup discussed local politics daily.

meaning_en: A report containing news of an organization.
example_en: The school sends out a weekly newsletter to parents.
examples_extra: We send a free monthly newsletter to members.
She edits our club newsletter every month.

meaning_en: A notice of a death, especially in a newspaper.
example_en: I read her obituary in the local newspaper this morning.
examples_extra: She sadly read his long obituary yesterday.
The local paper printed a respectful obituary.

meaning_en: Content that causes strong displeasure or anger.
example_en: The website was criticized for hosting offensive material.
examples_extra: The site removed offensive material.
He posted offensive material online.

meaning_en: Rich, luxurious, and lavish.
example_en: The magazine featured an opulent mansion with a grand ballroom.
examples_extra: They live in opulent surroundings.
The hotel looks quite opulent.

meaning_en: To treat someone or yourself with great care and luxury.
example_en: After a long week, she decided to pamper herself at the spa.
examples_extra: Go and pamper yourself today.
She pampers herself every month.

meaning_en: A small, thin book with information or advertising.
example_en: The tourist office provides free pamphlets about local attractions.
examples_extra: They published a new pamphlet.
Please read this pamphlet carefully.

meaning_en: Features allowing parents to restrict children's access to content.
example_en: Parental control settings help protect children online.
examples_extra: Set up parental controls on the TV.
Parental controls block adult websites.

meaning_en: To promote a product or service publicly.
example_en: The band went on TV to plug their new album.
examples_extra: She plugged her new book.
He kept plugging the show.

meaning_en: To publish or display information online.
example_en: She posted her vacation photos on social media.
examples_extra: I will post the photos tonight.
She posted the letter yesterday.
note_fa: منتشر کردن؛ انتشار اطلاعات به‌صورت آنلاین.

meaning_en: An official statement issued to news organizations.
example_en: The company issued a press release about its new product.
examples_extra: The company issued a press release.
Read the full press release online.

meaning_en: A document describing a school, business, or investment.
example_en: I read the university prospectus before applying.
examples_extra: Read the university prospectus carefully.
The prospectus lists all the courses.

meaning_en: Demonstrated or shown to be true or effective.
example_en: This method has a proven track record of success.
examples_extra: It is a proven and reliable method.
The drug has proven effective.

meaning_en: To ask someone a difficult question unexpectedly.
meaning_fa: کسی را در تنگنا قرار دادن
example_en: The journalist tried to put the politician on the spot.
examples_extra: The question really put him in a tight spot.
Journalists put the minister with hard questions.
note_fa: کسی را در تنگنا قرار دادن با سؤال دشوار.

meaning_en: Showing great joy, love, or health; shining brightly.
example_en: The bride looked absolutely radiant on her wedding day.
examples_extra: She looked radiant on her wedding day.
The happy bride was radiant with joy.

meaning_en: at the lowest possible level or price
example_en: The company's stock prices hit rock-bottom last week.
examples_extra: The shop cut prices to rock-bottom levels for the sale.
Morale hit rock-bottom after the third defeat in a row.
note_fa: کف؛ rock-bottom prices: قیمت‌های بسیار پایین.

meaning_en: Two advertising boards worn by a person, one front, one back.
example_en: A man walked around with a sandwich board advertising a new cafe.
examples_extra: A man wearing a sandwich board advertised the new café.
She handed out flyers next to the sandwich board man.

meaning_en: To filter or remove unwanted information or people.
example_en: We need to screen out irrelevant comments from the forum.
examples_extra: The software screens out spam before it reaches you.
Employers screen out hundreds of applications within minutes.

meaning_en: Writing words in the sky using smoke from an aircraft.
example_en: We saw an advertisement in sky-writing.
examples_extra: The plane did some sky-writing.
Sky-writing advertised the big event.

meaning_en: To cut or reduce something drastically.
example_en: The newspaper decided to slash its prices.
examples_extra: They slashed prices by half.
The company slashed costs drastically.

meaning_en: To be very noticeable or different from others.
meaning_fa: متمایز بودن، در میان جمع برجسته بودن
example_en: To succeed, your product needs to stand out in the crowd.
examples_extra: Her bright scarf made her stand out in the crowd.
These ties will make you stand out in the crowd.

meaning_en: Using the very latest technology or methods.
example_en: The new studio features state-of-the-art recording equipment.
examples_extra: The lab has state-of-the-art equipment.
Their new phones are state-of-the-art.

meaning_en: Extremely rich, luxurious, and magnificent.
example_en: The film featured sumptuous costumes and sets.
examples_extra: They served a sumptuous feast.
The hotel lobby was sumptuous.

meaning_en: An extra part of a newspaper or magazine.
example_en: The Sunday paper included a travel supplement.
examples_extra: She takes a vitamin supplement daily.
The magazine comes with a free supplement.

meaning_en: In a way that makes you want something but cannot have it.
example_en: The solution was tantalisingly close, yet still out of reach.
examples_extra: The prize remained tantalisingly out of reach.
He came tantalisingly close to winning.

meaning_en: A short preview of a film or TV show.
example_en: The trailer for the new movie looks exciting.
examples_extra: Did you see the trailer for the new film?
The trailer looks absolutely amazing.

meaning_en: Better than any other; supreme.
example_en: The quality of their journalism is unsurpassed.
examples_extra: Their quality remains unsurpassed in the industry.
He has unsurpassed skill as a surgeon.

meaning_en: An online seminar or presentation conducted over the internet.
example_en: I attended a fascinating webinar on digital marketing.
examples_extra: She joined a webinar on AI.
The webinar starts at noon.
